title: The Hidden Cost of Not Sleeping: What Sleep Deprivation Does to the Economy
description: The US loses $411 billion per year to sleep deprivation. This video explores the full economic, health, and productivity toll of the global sleep crisis — with real data, country comparisons, and surprising findings from landmark research.
cancelReason: Project abandoned by decision. Video was production-complete but never published.
